annotation.title_clean: H.R. 2864: To amend the Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019 to add DJI Technologies equipment and services to the covered list
annotation.title_en: H.R. 2864: To amend the Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019 to add DJI Technologies equipment and services to the covered list
annotation.authors_or_issuer: U.S. House of Representatives (Rep. Stefanik and Rep. Gallagher)
named_instruments_referenced: Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019
annotation.summary_en: US House bill H.R. 2864 (118th Congress), introduced April 2023 by Reps. Stefanik and Gallagher, would amend the Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019 to add DJI Technologies equipment and services (drones) to the FCC covered list over national security concerns. Referred to the Energy and Commerce Committee.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends the Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019 (47 U.S.C. 1601).
Adds DJI Technologies equipment and services to the covered communications equipment list.
Introduced April 25, 2023 and referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce.
